acceptance_criterion.claim: selected candidate is worth experimental validation
acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Close in composition to S1C01, but its slightly higher MDI level has no supplied thermal-hold evidence.
Matches the normalized proportions of E5, whose measured viscosity increased much more from 15 to 60 min at 120 C than E1.

selection_rationale: S1C01 matches the normalized composition of E1, the strongest supplied thermal-hold reference. E1 increased from 708.7 at 15 min to 776.1 at 60 min at 120 C, substantially less drift than E5 over the same window.

evidence_coverage.note: Thermal-hold measurements were available only for E1 and E5.

extrapolation.note: S1C01 matches E1 by normalized composition, but equivalence under the validation process remains unconfirmed.

measurement.note: Viscosity units and measurement method were not supplied.

process_history.note: Preparation and prior thermal histories were not supplied.

repeatability.note: Only one thermal-hold series was supplied for E1.
